findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-501.11: The gasket of the left double door cooler is observed in disrepair and held together with tape. This is not an approved method of repair. The gasket needs to be removed and replaced with a new one that creates a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface. 
4-501.11: (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in good repair. (B) EQUIPMENT components shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted to manufacturer’s specifications. (C) Cutting or piercing parts of can opens shall be kept sharp to minimize metal fragmentation.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: There was observed a few old mouse droppings in the dry storage closet. PIC was made aware and immediately cleaned and sanitized the surfaces with the old droppings. Ensure these areas are observed and cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The ground fans in the kitchen are observed to have an accumulation of dust/soil residues. Ensure the cage surfaces are maintained clean to not pose a contamination hazard to the surrounding surfaces in the path of the air.
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.111: There are fresh mouse droppings observed in the dry storage of the facility. There are mouse traps and glue traps present. Facility needs to clean the drippings out from under the shelving to better monitor the pest issue and determine the extent to which the mice are present. A 10 day follow-up is being issued for 2/14/2023 to observe the cleaning and to observe progress in the pest eradication.
6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The fans in the facility are observed to have an accumulation of dust/soil debris. Ensure these fans are cleaned and sanitized and then cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of dust/soil.
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: There are observed under the triple sink and under the shelves in the dry storage old mouse droppings. Ensure that equipment is pulled away from walls if able and that the hard to reach areas of the kitchen receive attention to detail when it comes to cleaning.
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.111: Facility is observed to have a mouse issue that maintenance is currently trying to eradicate. There was a reported mouse on the glue trap this morning and then mouse droppings were present in the dry storage and kitchen area.Glue traps are placed throughout the kitchen and dry storage, maintenance is routinely sweeping up the droppings. Facility must monitor the situation and continuously check food items for damage from rodents, no damage observed during today’s inspection. Ensure that droppings are removed from floor routinely to ensure accurate monitoring of issue. 
6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: Observed the caulking by the triple sink and the dish machine to be degrading in quality and resulting in a slight gap between the metal and the wall. Ensure the caulking is replaced in order for the surface to be smooth, non-absorbent, and easily cleanable.
PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: Non-food contact surfaces such as the carts in the dry storage have what appear to be a few rodent droppings on them. District pest control operator was on site yesterday as reported by PIC and as evidenced by dates on new glue traps for routine treatment. He did not notify of any issues. This appears to be a cleaning issue rather than an active pest issue. Clean carts and any remaining droppings and monitor. Alert pest control as needed.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13  (C) Clean all non-food contact surfaces frequently to prevent soil accumulation.  Reference 4-602.13.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the can opener blade to be soiled.  The blade was cleaned during the inspection. (IMMEDIATELY CORRECTED)
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed a small leak at the left faucet of three compartment sink.  Repair the leak.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
The dish machine rinse cycle water temperature reads 255 degrees on the digital readout.  Water cannot be more than 212 degrees (boiling point).  Have the temperature sensor or gauge adjusted or repaired so the readout is accurate.  (NOTE:  A temperature test strip was affixed to a cup and run through the machine to insure the final rinse water was hot enough to change the color of the strip - 180 degrees at the manifold).
750-830c A thermometer ±3°F shall be provided to check the temperature of  the water in each tank of the dish machine and the temperature of  the final rinse water as it enters the manifold.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment:
The food trays on the cart outside the kitchen were uncovered.  Cover the trays, invert them, or invert the top tray until ready to serve food.
750-850 Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  Spoons, knives and forks shall be touched only by their handles.  Cups glasses, bowls, plates and similar items shall be handled without contact with inside surfaces or with surfaces that contact the user’s mouth.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
The floor drain below the dish machine was soiled.  Clean the drain.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
(A) The corner of the red top cabinet at the end of the steam table is chipped on the edge.  (REPEAT VIOLATION)   (B) The edge of the red top cabinet on which the can opener is mounted is chipped on the edge.   (C) The bottoms of the wood cabinets by the window are in need of refinishing.      (D) The shelves in the wood cabinets opposite the 3-pan sink are chipping and are in need of refinishing. (REPEAT VIOLATION)
Refinish / repair the cabinet tops and shelves / bottoms of the cabinets.     750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
The floor under the dish machine and around the floor drain to the left of the dish machine is soiled close to the wall.  Clean the floor.

750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
The wall behind and below the dish machine is lightly soiled. Clean the wall.

750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean.
